metric_definitions: Primary Review Score (Rule D-3) = Score (1–5) from the most recent review per order.
Late Delivery = order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date (is_late = 1).
1-Star Share (%) = % of reviewed delivered orders in the bucket receiving a 1-star rating.
demo_question_responses.factual_summary: Yes — late delivery is strongly and significantly associated with lower review scores (Mann-Whitney U p < 0.0001, Welch's t = 96.49). Orders delivered 8+ days early (71,303 orders) average 4.32 / 5.00 stars (6.47% 1-star rate), whereas orders 1–3 days late (1,870 orders) drop to 3.29 stars (25.11% 1-star rate), and orders 8+ days late (2,862 orders) plunge to 1.70 stars with 69.87% 1-star reviews. Overall, on-time delivered orders (91.89%) average 4.29 stars vs 2.57 stars for late orders (8.11%, -1.72 star drop).
demo_question_responses.business_interpretation: Missing the estimated delivery date is the single largest operational driver of 1-star reviews on the marketplace: the 1-star review rate jumps more than 5x from 8.94% on-time to 46.46% late (and nearly 70% when delayed 8+ days).
recommended_actions: Recalibrate Estimated Delivery Date (EDD) buffers on high-delay corridors (RJ and Northeast states) and trigger proactive delay notifications before the promised date expires.
Cutting the 8.11% late delivery rate in half (~3,913 orders) would prevent an estimated ~1,468 1-star reviews and lift overall marketplace rating from 4.15 to 4.22 stars.
limitations: Primary review score uses the most recent review per order (Rule D-3). Association is observational across 95,824 reviewed delivered orders with valid delivery timestamps.

demo_question_responses.business_interpretation: Combining second-order retention automation with corridor-specific EDD recalibration and top-decile seller SLA governance addresses the highest-leverage revenue and satisfaction bottlenecks.
recommended_actions: Action 1 (CRM & Retention): Launch 30-to-45 day post-delivery replenishment vouchers targeting 37,219 'Recent Customers' in health_beauty, bed_bath_table, and watches_gifts (Target: lift D-5 repeat rate from 2.16% to 3.50%–4.00%, +R$ 200K–R$ 275K order value proxy).

Action 3 (Key-Account Seller Governance): Establish dedicated account management and dispatch SLA gates for the 297 Decile-1 sellers representing R$ 8.87M (67.11%) of item sales.
Action 4 (Regional Fulfillment Expansion): Recruit local 3PL/seller inventory in RJ, BA, and PE to reduce average interstate freight ratios (currently 20%–29% in North/Northeast vs 12% in SP).

audit_trail.question: How do delivery delays affect customer review scores?
audit_trail.sql_query: WITH delay_classified AS (  SELECT order_id, payment_value, delivery_days, is_late, review_score,   DATEDIFF(order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date) AS delay_calendar_days,   CASE     WHEN DATEDIFF(order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date) <= -8 THEN '1. Early (8+ days early)'     WHEN DATEDIFF(order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date) BETWEEN -7 AND -1 THEN '2. Early (1-7 days early)'     WHEN DATEDIFF(order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date) = 0 THEN '3. On Estimated Date (0 days)'     WHEN DATEDIFF(order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '4. Slightly Late (1-3 days)'     WHEN DATEDIFF(order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '5. Moderately Late (4-7 days)'     ELSE '6. Severely Late (8+ days)'   END AS delivery_timing_bucket   FROM order_level   WHERE is_delivered = 1 AND missing_delivery_date = 0 AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT delivery_timing_bucket, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0), 2) AS order_share_pct, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS order_value_proxy_brl, ROUND(AVG(delivery_days), 2) AS avg_actual_delivery_days, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(review_score), 0), 2) AS one_star_share_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(review_score), 0), 2) AS five_star_share_pct FROM delay_classified GROUP BY delivery_timing_bucket ORDER BY delivery_timing_bucket
audit_trail.factual_summary: Yes — late delivery is strongly and significantly associated with lower review scores (Mann-Whitney U p < 0.0001, Welch's t = 96.49). Orders delivered 8+ days early (71,303 orders) average 4.32 / 5.00 stars (6.47% 1-star rate), whereas orders 1–3 days late (1,870 orders) drop to 3.29 stars (25.11% 1-star rate), and orders 8+ days late (2,862 orders) plunge to 1.70 stars with 69.87% 1-star reviews. Overall, on-time delivered orders (91.89%) average 4.29 stars vs 2.57 stars for late orders (8.11%, -1.72 star drop).
